_readme: Case-study whitespace priorities: segment × market cells sales should fill. priority 'owner' = named by Aayush Vishnoi (29 Oct 2026); 'suggested' = proposed in the Hub from Bromic's stated strategy, to be confirmed by the regional lead. Prospect profiles are kinds of property, never named companies; no figures are asserted. The Hub's whitespace grid reads this file; every other empty cell is shown as open whitespace.

targets.why: Open-air concourses, premium seating decks and club terraces are cold for the shoulder seasons of football and baseball; no Bromic stadium story exists on any site.
targets.prospects: Pro and college stadiums with premium clubs or rooftop decks; minor-league ballparks; amphitheatres; their concessionaires and design-build firms.
targets.controls: Affinity Smart-Heat On/Off or Dimmer, 5-channel controllers per zone, BMS via the expansion board
targets.capture: Zones and heater count, event-day schedule, BMS integration, before/after use of premium spaces (with permission), architect and design-builder credits
targets.angle: Premium seats sold and used for more of the season
targets.owner: Blake Petty [[VERIFY: owner for stadium outreach — Blake Petty]]

targets.why: Shelters and veterinary campuses have outdoor runs, adoption patios and waiting areas where radiant heat warms animals and people, not air; no story exists.
targets.prospects: Municipal and non-profit animal shelters, humane societies, veterinary hospitals, boarding and daycare facilities, and the architects who design them.
targets.controls: Affinity Smart-Heat On/Off with schedules, wall switch per run
targets.capture: Which spaces are heated (runs, play yards, adoption patio), mounting height and clearances near animals, cleaning and washdown, staff schedule, quote from the director
targets.angle: Warm outdoor runs and adoption spaces, safely out of reach
targets.owner: [[VERIFY: owner for animal-care outreach — Karl Tschauner]]

targets.why: The only multifamily story is Industrie in Albany NY; Australian build-to-rent and apartment rooftops are a large, design-led segment with none.
targets.prospects: Build-to-rent operators, apartment developers with rooftop or podium amenity decks, and their architects and builders.
targets.controls: Affinity Smart-Heat with schedules and the app for building managers
targets.capture: Amenity spaces, all-electric angle, resident booking or use (with permission), architect and builder credits, metric and imperial sizes
targets.angle: Amenity decks residents use all year
targets.owner: [[VERIFY: AU owner for multifamily — AU sales lead]]

targets.why: The builder channel push (A15, A16) has no reference project; Dorrington Homes in Perth is the only builder story, and only in photos.
targets.prospects: Production and semi-custom builders offering covered outdoor rooms as an upgrade; their model homes.
targets.controls: Affinity Smart-Heat On/Off or Dimmer, wall switch
targets.capture: Pre-wire standard, upgrade take rate (with permission), model-home photos, sales-centre quote
targets.angle: Designed from the start, not added later

targets.why: The sales deck cites a Toronto recessing project that no site carries; Canada has no written case study at all.
targets.prospects: Custom-home builders and architects in Toronto, Vancouver and Calgary; Muskoka and cottage-country renovations.
targets.controls: Affinity Smart-Heat Dimmer, wall switch, app
targets.capture: Recess detail, cold-climate use, 208/240 V, CSA/cETL marks, homeowner quote
targets.angle: Recessed heat for a Canadian season
targets.owner: Sean [[VERIFY: West Canada; East owner TBD — Aayush Vishnoi]]

targets.why: Patio seasons are short and patio programmes are civic priorities in Canadian cities; no Canadian restaurant story exists.
targets.prospects: Restaurant groups and hotels with year-round patios in Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver and Calgary.
targets.capture: Months added to the patio season, covers (with permission), municipal patio rules

targets.why: Hotel and restaurant terraces are the Middle East focus; the region has no case study on any site.
targets.prospects: Luxury hotels and resorts with rooftop and terrace dining in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar; their interior and landscape architects.
targets.capture: Winter-evening use, design integration, operator quote

targets.why: Italy and Germany are named growth markets; Europe has restaurant photos (Oslo, Brussels) but no written restaurant case study outside London.
targets.prospects: Restaurants and hotel terraces worked through the Italian and German partners.
targets.capture: Local-language quote, partner credit, design integration
targets.angle: Terrace dining through the shoulder seasons
targets.owner: Francesco / Raffaele Marti [[VERIFY: confirm — regional leads]]

targets.why: Senior-living campuses invest in outdoor courtyards and dining terraces where gentle radiant heat suits residents; no story exists.
targets.prospects: Senior-living operators and their architects; continuing-care campuses.
targets.capture: Resident use, staff schedule, clearances, operator quote
targets.angle: Courtyards residents can use in the cool months

targets.why: University dining terraces and student-union patios extend usable space; no campus story exists.
targets.prospects: University facilities and dining services; campus architects.
targets.capture: Seats added outdoors, schedule, all-electric campus goals
targets.angle: More usable campus space without a new building

targets.why: Tasting patios drive visits and club sign-ups; no winery or brewery story exists in any market.
targets.prospects: Wineries and tasting rooms in California, Oregon and Washington; craft breweries with beer gardens.
targets.capture: Evening and off-season use, events, owner quote

targets.why: Kahite in Tennessee is the only golf story; Australian golf and bowling clubs have large covered terraces (Sunbury Bowling Club's case study is lost).
targets.prospects: Golf, bowling and RSL clubs with covered terraces and bistros.
targets.capture: Members' use in winter, functions booked, club manager quote
